limitations: Identity closure is offline evidence work — no terminal-owned chain or Blender/form rerun is claimed.
NinjaPCR CJT1117B-3.3-G accepts a closed ESP8266 load budget (≤170 mA TX peak) on gold 2 oz copper; a sustained 500 mA continuous 12 V rail exceeds that thermal closure and must not be reintroduced.
No candidate without manufacturer ordering-code evidence was promoted; OpenDrop LED/ferrite/header identities are catalogue fills of frozen land patterns, not invented gold BOM codes.
NinjaPCR TEC continuous current remains connector-capped at GS012S 7 A with an engineering freeze ≤5.6 A pending a named TEC MPN.
